name: china-bachelor-programmes
title: Bachelor Programmes Open to International Students at Chinese Universities (2026)
description: Bachelor Programmes Open to International Students at Chinese Universities (2026): Every bachelor programme in the international catalogues of the universities, with language of instruction and a STEM flag, plus counts per university. The Long Bet, original research by M. Atamanova. Snapshot 2026-10-23.

fields.name: programme_id
fields.description: Row id: `<university_id>__<programme slug>` (a suffix -2, -3 separates programmes of the same name in different schools or languages).

fields.name: university_id
fields.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets (e.g. `tsinghua-university`).

fields.name: programme_name_en
fields.description: Programme (major) name in English as listed in the catalogue.

fields.name: school_or_faculty
fields.description: School, faculty or department that runs the programme.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of instruction: `zh` Chinese, `en` English, `zh_en` bilingual, `fr` French.

fields.name: is_stem
fields.description: `true` for natural sciences, mathematics, computing, engineering, materials, earth, environmental and life sciences, biomedical engineering; `false` for medicine, pharmacy, architecture, economics, business, humanities and social sciences. Classified from the programme name.

fields.name: joint_institute
fields.description: Name of the joint institute or partner university when the programme is run with one; null otherwise.

fields.name: status
fields.description: `found` = the fact was read on the source page; `not_found` = the page was checked and the fact is not there: the row records what was looked for, `source_url` gives the URL tried and `note` says what was missing.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Page(s) where the fact is stated, "; "-separated, primary pages first. For `not_found` rows: the page(s) tried.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: `official` = university, government, embassy, airport or ranking publisher page; `law` = legal act; `secondary` = media, Wikipedia, agencies, aggregators.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date the row was last read on the source, ISO 8601.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: `verified` = read on an official or legal page for the current cycle; `partial` = official but older cycle or incomplete, or a reputable secondary source; `estimate` = derived or calculated, method in `note`. Empty for `not_found` rows.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Caveats in English. "Updated 2026-10-23:" marks text added by the second verification pass of 23 October 2026.

fields.name: university_id
fields.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets (e.g. `tsinghua-university`).

fields.name: catalogue_url
fields.description: Catalogue page or file the counts were taken from.

fields.name: catalogue_cycle
fields.description: Intake or year of the catalogue.

fields.name: intl_bachelor_programmes_total
fields.description: Number of bachelor programmes open to international applicants in the catalogue (Chinese-taught plus English-taught).

fields.name: zh_taught_count
fields.description: Number of Chinese-taught bachelor programmes open to international applicants; null = list not readable.

fields.name: en_taught_count
fields.description: Number of English-taught bachelor programmes run by the university itself (joint institutes excluded).

fields.name: en_taught_stem_count
fields.description: Of `en_taught_count`, programmes with `is_stem` = true.

fields.name: zh_taught_stem_count
fields.description: Of `zh_taught_count`, programmes with `is_stem` = true.

fields.name: en_taught_list
fields.description: English-taught programmes, "; "-separated.

fields.name: joint_institutes
fields.description: Joint institutes or dual-degree programmes with a foreign university.

fields.name: class_composition_en
fields.description: Whether English-taught classes mix international and Chinese students: `mixed_with_chinese` or `unknown`.

fields.name: class_composition_zh
fields.description: Same for Chinese-taught classes.

fields.name: duration_years_en
fields.description: Duration of English-taught programmes. Unit: years (range as text).

fields.name: duration_years_zh
fields.description: Duration of Chinese-taught programmes. Unit: years (range as text; medicine is longer).

fields.name: fee_differs_en_vs_zh
fields.description: `true` if English-taught programmes cost more than Chinese-taught ones; `unknown` if not stated.

fields.name: switch_en_to_zh_allowed
fields.description: Whether a student can move from an English-taught to a Chinese-taught programme: `true`, `false`, `unknown`.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source id, S001 upwards.

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL as cited in the data (spaces encoded as %20).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Publisher and host of the page.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: `official`, `law` or `secondary` (most frequent type of the rows citing it).

fields.name: accessed_at
fields.description: Latest date a row citing the URL was checked, ISO 8601.

fields.name: used_for
fields.description: File, column and number of rows that cite the URL.
